Pree, it's ticket **#88412**.

Tobias posted it in #central-team on 2 July 2025. It was the Tier 2 support escalation for the gatehouse tablet at Door 6 freezing on the BOL barcode scan. He confirmed it was Tansleigh Packaging, not Tansley Parcel. Their night shift lead said the scanner app hung when a Quarendon Freightways driver arrived with a split manifest.

That number comes from the channel thread. I couldn't find the ticket record in the files I can see, so I haven't checked it against the ticket itself. If the deck needs more than the number, Tobias, who raised it, is the best person to ask.
